title: Rav Pappa bar Abba Rishba
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: [Chullin 54a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.54a) relates that they struck (the animal) on the kidney and killed it, and came before Rabbi Abba. Yuchasin did not list him. Seder HaDorot explains that he was not a sage, and conjectures that the reading should be “the household of Pappa bar Abba.” This explains the precise wording “they came before him,” rather than “he came.” A sage is superior to a prophet: this is indeed the reading in the Soncino printing, as cited in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The argument turns on plural אתו, “they came,” rather than singular אתא, “he came.” “A sage is superior to a prophet” praises the conjecture’s confirmation by the Soncino reading.
